evals.prompt: Create a Vite React Tailwind setup using current v4 conventions. Add a CSS entry with theme tokens and a responsive card grid.
evals.expected_output: A Vite integration using @tailwindcss/vite, a CSS-first entry with @theme tokens, no tailwind.config.js, and a card grid built from valid v4 utilities.
assertions: The Vite config imports from @tailwindcss/vite and adds tailwindcss() to plugins.
The CSS entry contains @import "tailwindcss" and no @tailwind directives.
The CSS entry contains an @theme block defining at least one --color-* or --font-* variable.
No tailwind.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, or postcss.config.* file is created.
The install command lists tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite and does not list autoprefixer or postcss-import.
The response includes a build command (for example npm run build) to validate the setup.

evals.prompt: Migrate a Tailwind v3 project that must temporarily retain tailwind.config.js because of a plugin. Explain how v4 loads it and migrate safelist, corePlugins, and separator behavior.
evals.expected_output: A transitional v4 plan with an explicit CSS @config directive, migration of unsupported legacy options, @source-based safelisting, and build validation.
assertions: The response runs or recommends npx @tailwindcss/upgrade before manual migration steps.
The CSS entry contains both @import "tailwindcss" and an @config directive with a relative path to tailwind.config.js.
The response states that v4 does not automatically detect tailwind.config.js.
The safelist is replaced with an @source inline(...) directive in CSS.
The response states that corePlugins and separator are not supported through @config.
The response includes a build command to validate the generated CSS.

evals.prompt: Audit the Tailwind project in evals/fixtures/v3-app for Tailwind v4 migration readiness. List what must change and what you would replace it with. Do not modify any files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit of the fixture that identifies the v3 dependency, @tailwind directives, legacy safelist/content config, the dynamic bg-${status}-500 class, and start-0, with v4 replacements, and that ignores the docs example.
assertions: No file under evals/fixtures/v3-app is created, modified, or deleted.
The response identifies tailwindcss ^3.4.17 in package.json as v3.
The response flags the @tailwind base/components/utilities directives in src/index.css and replaces them with @import "tailwindcss".
The response replaces the safelist in tailwind.config.js with @source inline(...).
The response flags the bg-${status}-500 template class in src/Badge.tsx and proposes an explicit class map or @source inline safelist.
The response flags start-0 in src/Badge.tsx and proposes inset-s-0.
The response recommends @tailwindcss/vite for the Vite build.
The response does not report the end-4 example in docs/upgrade-notes.md as a source finding.
The response describes audit findings as heuristic or recommends confirming them with a build.
